results.q: Circles stores data on a Blockchain. What’s a blockchain?
results.a: Circles data is stored on a blockchain. A blockchain is like having many sets of identical bookkeeping that are saved in multiple digital locations that don't know each other but all confirm the data, so there is no chance for anyone to tamper with the data. This means the data is very accurate and safe!

In essence, a blockchain is a digital, accountable public ledger that exists across a network. While blockchains are often associated with cryptocurrencies, they are also used for storing all kinds of data.




Some notable uses of Blockchain technology today include for secure voting; for distribution of government benefits; for storing medical information; for noting Digital Art rights (NFTs); for logistics and supply chain tracking and many others!

results.q: Is Circles UBI the same as other UBI Projects?
results.a:
No, Circles is quite different from most UBI Projects because most UBI Projects distribute cash funds and are usually given by the government to the people. 




Circles is an independent non-profit initiative that distributes cashless, non-fungible complementary resources in the form of Circles Points.




By distributing non-fungible digital points (i.e. Circles Points cannot be exchanged for fiat or crypto currencies), Circles Indonesia stimulates participating communities to build a localised, trust-based complementary means of exchanging goods and services in the form of points. This means the Circles UBI system can flourish without huge budgets for cash disbursements.

Not yet! At the moment only pre-selected research participants in specific locations in Bali can use Circles Points.

On 27 October 2017, the Indonesian Basic Income Guarantee (IndoBIG) Network was established as an informal network of researchers and activists interested in studying and trialling UBI implementation in Indonesia. The IndoBIG Network is committed to provide education in Indonesia regarding UBI developments in the world.




On October 2, 2019, the IndoBIG Network became formally affiliated with the UBI Lab Network based in England. UBI Lab Jakarta was established as part of the Think Tank network between the UBI Lab Network and IndoBIG Network.

results.q: Is Circles useful for people with limited funds?
results.a:
Yes. All Circles users will receive 24 Circles Points for free, everyday!

These points can be used to enhance people's ability to meet their daily needs by providing additional resources to exchange for goods/services.
